offering_description.value: Distributes natural gas through its regulated utility subsidiary, Roanoke Gas, to residential, commercial and industrial customers in the Roanoke, Virginia area and nearby communities. It delivers gas through its own pipeline network and sells gas at regulated rates.

primary_services.value: natural gas distribution; gas delivery and utility service

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential natural gas customers; B2B: commercial and industrial gas users

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial buildings; industrial energy

revenue_model.value: product sales: natural gas sold to customers at regulated rates; service fees: regulated delivery and customer charges for gas distribution

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates local gas distribution pipelines, buying gas from suppliers and selling to end customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Roanoke, Virginia area and surrounding communities in western Virginia

specialization.value: niche specialist: regulated natural gas distribution utility

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: gas delivered directly to customers through its own pipeline network

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates and operations regulated by the Virginia State Corporation Commission and federal pipeline safety rules

notes: The company also holds a minority interest in the Mountain Valley Pipeline, which is excluded.
